ii.1) Monoculture [EMP]* Monocultures maximize production by focusing on a single crop, usually genetically modified and lacking polyvarieties, replacing on-site plant diversity and significant adjacent plant diversity via edge effects and fragmentation compared to polycultures.
ii.2) Polycultures / hybrid agroforestry [IAE]* Primarily practiced by smallholder and mid-scale producers (with, e.g., coffee, cocoa, açaí, black pepper), this approach incorporates diverse plant species and trees, enhancing agricultural diversification, income sources, and environmental recovery.
ii.3) Forest management for timber and non-timber forest products [MNS]* Forest management, the extraction of timber and non-timber forest products (NTFPs) at a larger scale, includes a variety of best management practices to support its sustainability.
